summary: Iteration 3 focused solely on the v3 Usage Analytics feature. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py (10 tests, all passing) covering auth gating, full response schema, 30-entry daily_spend window, preferred_template, breakdown sort order, totals/breakdown consistency, and a live FAQ message increment test (1 LLM streaming call). Frontend: Playwright run on /analytics with cookie session_token=test_session_seed_001 — analytics-page renders, 4 KPI cards, recharts area chart rendered with 30-day series, template-breakdown table with 5 rows incl. 'Konut Değerleme Raporu', back-to-dashboard-btn navigates to /dashboard, sidebar analytics-btn ('Kullanım Analitiği') navigates to /analytics. No console errors, no error elements. Backend 100%, frontend 100%.

minor.issue: totals.topped_up is serialized as int 0 (not 0.0) when there are no top-ups in the window (round(sum([]),2) -> 0). Spec calls for float; wrap in float() for consistent typing.

kpis.avg_spend_per_report divides TOTAL 30d spend (incl. FAQ + in-progress reports) by reports_completed, yielding an inflated ₺106.5 vs actual konut spend ₺88 for 2 reports. Metric label ('tamamlanan rapor başına') is misleading.

template_breakdown rows show reports 0/0 for templates that have usage_events but no chats in the window (Ticari/Endüstriyel/Arsa). Deleting a chat leaves its usage_events, so spend can be attributed to templates with no report count — consistent as a ledger, but data can look inconsistent in the UI.

issues: Recharts logs repeated console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial mount (ResponsiveContainer measured before layout). Chart still renders correctly; add minHeight/minWidth to silence.
Layout, contrast and spacing reviewed at 1920x1080 — no contrast or alignment problems found.

action_items: Optional: clarify or recompute avg_spend_per_report (exclude FAQ / non-report spend) and/or relabel the KPI
Optional: pass minHeight to ResponsiveContainer to remove recharts width/height warning
critical_code_review_comments: /api/analytics/summary uses ISO-string comparison on created_at for the 30d window; works because all writes use timezone-aware isoformat, but any legacy/non-UTC-offset record would sort incorrectly. Consider storing epoch/datetime for range queries.
server.py is 906 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting analytics/wallet routers into modules.
Analytics.jsx fetch has no loading spinner distinction between 'no user yet' and 'fetching' (only plain text) and no retry on error — acceptable but minimal.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. The increment test created + deleted one FAQ chat; its usage_event remains by design so seed usage_events is now 46 (was 45) and today's daily_spend includes +2 TL. wallet_balance reset back to 150.0 after testing.
test_credentials: session_token=test_session_seed_001 (Bearer header for API, cookie for UI), user_id=test-user-seed-001
context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics is fully validated (backend + UI). Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (wallet/Stripe/SSE) and /app/backend/tests/test_analytics.py. Note pytest.ini runs xdist with LoadScope, so module-scoped fixtures execute per worker; the increment test is deselectable via -k 'not Increment' to avoid extra LLM calls. Seed usage_events count is now 46, not 45 — assert >= 45 rather than == 45.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The two initial test failures were artifacts of my own assertions ('_id' substring matched 'template_id', and topped_up int-vs-float) and were corrected in the test file; the int typing of topped_up is logged as a minor backend nit.
